errors.evidence: The x-axis represents the model index, but there is no explicit unit '个' (count/item) stated on the axis.
The solid line in the plot does not have any markers; describing it as having 'empty circle' markers is incorrect.
The point at x=3 is a local minimum, but the description incorrectly identifies it as the overall lowest point. The actual lowest point occurs at x=13.
The value at x=5 is approximately 2650, not 2900 as stated in the description. This is a significant overestimation.
